ko.title: 유럽의 모든 챗봇은 이제 "저는 기계입니다"라고 말해야 합니다: EU의 새로운 AI 공개법 내부 분석

segments.src: Starting August 2, a new phase of the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act has taken effect, and it changes something many internet users interact with every day without a second thought: the chatbot window, the customer service assistant, and the eerily convincing video clip shared on social media.
segments.tr: 8월 2일부터 유럽연합(EU)의 인공지능법(AI Act)의 새로운 단계가 발효되었으며, 이는 많은 인터넷 사용자가 매일 아무런 생각 없이 상호작용하는 것들, 즉 챗봇 창, 고객 서비스 어시스턴트, 그리고 소셜 미디어에서 공유되는 소름 돋을 정도로 설득력 있는 비디오 클립을 변화시킵니다.

segments.src: Under the bloc's transparency rules, AI systems that interact with people, generate synthetic media, or read human emotions now have to say so, clearly and up front.
segments.tr: EU의 투명성 규칙에 따라, 사람과 상호작용하거나 합성 미디어를 생성하거나 인간의 감정을 읽는 AI 시스템은 이제 이를 명확하고 사전에 고지해야 합니다.

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Requires
segments.tr: ## 규칙의 실제 요구 사항

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: AI법 제50조에 명시된 이 의무는 간단한 아이디어에서 시작되었습니다. 즉, 사람들은 자신이 인간이 아닌 기계와 거래하고 있다는 사실을 알 권리가 있다는 것입니다.

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: 실제로 이는 EU 시장에서 운영되는 기업들에게 몇 가지 구체적인 요구 사항으로 이어집니다.

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **챗봇 및 가상 어시스턴트**는 문맥상 이미 명백하지 않은 한, 사용자가 AI 시스템과 상호작용하고 있음을 공개해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **AI로 생성되었거나 조작된 이미지, 오디오 및 비디오** (일반적으로 딥페이크로 알려짐)는 인공적으로 생성되었거나 조작되었음을 표시해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **AI로 생성되었거나 편집된 텍스트**가 공공의 이익에 관한 사항으로 대중에게 알리기 위해 게시된 경우, 인간의 편집 검토를 거친 콘텐츠의 일부 예외를 제외하고는 그렇게 표시해야 합니다.

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **감정 인식 및 생체 인식 분류 시스템**은 이러한 기술이 자신에게 사용되고 있을 때 개인에게 통지해야 합니다.

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: 이 규칙은 광범위하게 적용되며, AI 개발자뿐만 아니라 이러한 도구를 배포하는 기업까지 포함합니다. 예를 들어, 제3자 챗봇을 사용하는 소매업체는 기본 모델을 구축한 회사가 아니라 소매업체 자체가 공개 책임이 있다는 의미입니다.

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## 규제 당국이 지금 이를 추진하는 이유

segments.src: The transparency requirement is part of a staged rollout that began when the AI Act entered into force in 2024.
segments.tr: 투명성 요구 사항은 2024년 AI법이 발효된 이후 시작된 단계적 도입의 일부입니다.

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: 이전 단계에서는 사회적 점수 매기기와 같은 좁은 범위의 "수용 불가능한 위험" 관행을 금지하고, 범용 AI 모델 제공업체에 대한 의무를 설정했습니다.

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: 이번 최신 마일스톤은 법의 영향력을 일상적인 소비자 대상 도구로 확장합니다.

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.
segments.tr: EU 관계자들은 이 조치를 합성 미디어가 오해, 사기 및 온라인상의 공공 신뢰 훼손에 미치는 역할에 대한 우려가 커짐에 따라 이에 대한 대응으로 규정했습니다.

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.
segments.tr: AI 생성 콘텐츠가 인간이 만든 자료와 구별하기 어려워짐에 따라, 규제 당국은 기본적인 표시 요구 사항이 비례적인 첫 번째 단계라고 주장합니다. 이는 기술에 대한 금지가 아니라, 사용에 대한 가드레일입니다.

segments.src: ## The Price of Getting It Wrong
segments.tr: ## 잘못되었을 때의 대가

segments.src: Enforcement carries real financial weight.
segments.tr: 집행은 실제적인 재정적 무게를 가집니다.

segments.src: Companies found to violate the transparency obligations can face fines of up to €15 million, or 3% of their total global annual revenue, whichever amount is higher.
segments.tr: 투명성 의무를 위반한 것으로 판명된 기업은 최대 1,500만 유로 또는 전 세계 연간 총 매출액의 3% 중 더 높은 금액의 벌금을 물 수 있습니다.

segments.src: For large multinational firms, that percentage-of-revenue calculation can dwarf the flat fee, making compliance a board-level concern rather than a minor legal footnote.
segments.tr: 대형 다국적 기업의 경우, 매출액 대비 비율로 계산된 금액이 정액 벌금보다 훨씬 클 수 있으며, 이는 준수 여부를 단순한 법적 각주가 아닌 이사회 수준의 관심사로 만듭니다.

segments.src: National market surveillance authorities in each EU member state are responsible for enforcement, working alongside the newly established EU AI Office, which coordinates oversight of general-purpose AI models across the bloc.
segments.tr: 각 EU 회원국의 국가 시장 감시 당국이 집행을 담당하며, EU 전역의 범용 AI 모델 감독을 조정하는 새로 설립된 EU AI 사무국과 협력합니다.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond Europe
segments.tr: ## 유럽 너머의 중요성

segments.src: Much like the GDPR reshaped global data privacy practices after its 2018 debut, the AI Act's disclosure rules are expected to influence how companies build products well outside EU borders.
segments.tr: 2018년 도입된 GDPR이 글로벌 데이터 프라이버시 관행을 재편한 것처럼, AI법의 공개 규칙은 EU 국경 밖의 기업들이 제품을 구축하는 방식에 영향을 미칠 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: Many businesses find it simpler to apply one global standard for labeling and disclosure rather than maintaining separate versions of a product for different markets.
segments.tr: 많은 기업들이 시장별로 제품의 별도 버전을 유지하는 것보다 레이블링 및 공개를 위한 하나의 글로벌 표준을 적용하는 것이 더 간단하다고 판단합니다.

segments.src: Developers of chatbots, content-generation tools, and customer-facing AI assistants are already reviewing their interfaces to add clear AI-identification notices, watermarking for synthetic media, and consent flows for emotion-detection features.
segments.tr: 챗봇, 콘텐츠 생성 도구 및 고객 대상 AI 어시스턴트 개발자들은 이미 인터페이스를 검토하여 명확한 AI 식별 공지, 합성 미디어에 대한 워터마킹, 감정 감지 기능에 대한 동의 절차를 추가하고 있습니다.

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
segments.tr: 일반 사용자들에게 실질적인 효과는 작지만 의미 있는 것이 될 것입니다. 즉, 지원 채팅의 상대방의 친절한 목소리나 온라인에서 유통되는 세련된 비디오 클립이 기계에 의해 생성되었거나 도움을 받았다는 것을 나타내는 짧은 레이블이나 공지가 표시될 것입니다.

segments.src: Whether that label meaningfully curbs misuse of synthetic media remains to be tested, but it marks one of the most concrete steps any major regulator has taken to draw a visible line between human and artificial communication.
segments.tr: 그러한 레이블이 합성 미디어의 오용을 의미 있게 억제할 수 있을지는 아직 테스트되어야 하지만, 이는 주요 규제 기관이 인간과 인공적 소통 사이의 가시적인 선을 긋기 위해 취한 가장 구체적인 조치 중 하나입니다.

zh.title: 欧洲所有聊天机器人现在必须声明“我是机器”：深入解析欧盟新 AI 披露法

segments.src: Starting August 2, a new phase of the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act has taken effect, and it changes something many internet users interact with every day without a second thought: the chatbot window, the customer service assistant, and the eerily convincing video clip shared on social media.
segments.tr: 从 8 月 2 日起，欧盟《人工智能法案》（AI Act）的一个新阶段正式生效，这改变了许多互联网用户每天在无意中接触的东西：聊天机器人窗口、客户服务助手，以及在社交媒体上分享的极具说服力的视频片段。

segments.src: Under the bloc's transparency rules, AI systems that interact with people, generate synthetic media, or read human emotions now have to say so, clearly and up front.
segments.tr: 根据该联盟的透明度规则，与人互动、生成合成媒体或读取人类情感的 AI 系统现在必须清晰且提前地予以声明。

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Requires
segments.tr: ## 规则的具体要求

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: 这项义务规定在《人工智能法案》第 50 条中，其核心理念很简单：人们有权知道他们是在与机器而非人类打交道。

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: 在实践中，这转化为在欧盟市场运营的公司必须遵守的几项具体要求。

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **聊天机器人和虚拟助手** 必须披露用户正在与 AI 系统互动，除非从上下文已经很明显。

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **AI 生成或篡改的图像、音频和视频** —— 通常被称为深度伪造（deepfakes） —— 必须被标记为人工生成或篡改。

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **AI 生成或编辑的文本** 若用于向公众告知公共利益事项，必须予以标记，但经过人类编辑审核的内容除外。

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **情感识别和生物识别分类系统** 在对个人使用此类技术时必须通知该个人。

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: 该规则适用范围广泛，不仅涵盖 AI 开发商，还涵盖部署这些工具的企业 —— 这意味着，例如，使用第三方聊天机器人的零售商，本身也承担披露责任，而不仅仅是构建底层模型的公司。

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## 监管机构为何现在推动此举

segments.src: The transparency requirement is part of a staged rollout that began when the AI Act entered into force in 2024.
segments.tr: 透明度要求是 2024 年《人工智能法案》生效后分阶段实施的一部分。

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: 早先的阶段禁止了一组狭窄的“不可接受风险”实践，例如社会信用评分，并为通用 AI 模型提供商设定了义务。

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: 最新的这一里程碑将法律的触角延伸到了日常面向消费者的工具中。

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.
segments.tr: 欧盟官员将此举定义为应对合成媒体在误导信息、诈骗以及侵蚀在线公共信任方面所起作用的日益担忧。

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.
segments.tr: 随着 AI 生成的内容越来越难以与人类创作的材料区分，监管机构认为，基础的标记要求是一个适度的第一步 —— 这不是对技术的禁令，而是对其使用设置的护栏。

segments.src: ## The Price of Getting It Wrong
segments.tr: ## 违规的代价

segments.src: Enforcement carries real financial weight.
segments.tr: 执法具有实际的财务压力。

segments.src: Companies found to violate the transparency obligations can face fines of up to €15 million, or 3% of their total global annual revenue, whichever amount is higher.
segments.tr: 被发现违反透明度义务的公司可能面临高达 1500 万欧元，或其全球年度总收入 3% 的罚款，以较高者为准。

segments.src: For large multinational firms, that percentage-of-revenue calculation can dwarf the flat fee, making compliance a board-level concern rather than a minor legal footnote.
segments.tr: 对于大型跨国公司来说，这种基于收入百分比的计算可能会远超固定金额，使得合规成为董事会级别关注的问题，而非简单的法律脚注。

segments.src: National market surveillance authorities in each EU member state are responsible for enforcement, working alongside the newly established EU AI Office, which coordinates oversight of general-purpose AI models across the bloc.
segments.tr: 每个欧盟成员国的国家市场监管机构负责执法，并与新成立的欧盟 AI 办公室合作，该办公室负责协调整个联盟内通用 AI 模型的监督。

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond Europe
segments.tr: ## 为什么这在欧洲之外也很重要

segments.src: Much like the GDPR reshaped global data privacy practices after its 2018 debut, the AI Act's disclosure rules are expected to influence how companies build products well outside EU borders.
segments.tr: 就像 2018 年 GDPR 重新塑造了全球数据隐私实践一样，《人工智能法案》的披露规则预计将影响公司在欧盟边界之外构建产品的方式。

segments.src: Many businesses find it simpler to apply one global standard for labeling and disclosure rather than maintaining separate versions of a product for different markets.
segments.tr: 许多企业发现，应用统一的全球标记和披露标准比为不同市场维护不同版本的产品更简单。

segments.src: Developers of chatbots, content-generation tools, and customer-facing AI assistants are already reviewing their interfaces to add clear AI-identification notices, watermarking for synthetic media, and consent flows for emotion-detection features.
segments.tr: 聊天机器人、内容生成工具和面向客户的 AI 助手开发商已经在审查其界面，以添加清晰的 AI 识别通知、合成媒体的水印以及情感检测功能的同意流程。

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
segments.tr: 对于普通用户来说，实际效果应该是微小但有意义的：一个简短的标签或通知，表明支持聊天另一端的友好声音，或在网上流传的精致视频片段，是由机器创建或辅助完成的。

segments.src: Whether that label meaningfully curbs misuse of synthetic media remains to be tested, but it marks one of the most concrete steps any major regulator has taken to draw a visible line between human and artificial communication.
segments.tr: 这种标签是否能有效遏制合成媒体的滥用仍有待验证，但这标志着任何主要监管机构在划定人类与人工智能沟通之间可见界限方面所采取的最具体步骤之一。

segments.tr: ## नियम वास्तव में क्या आवश्यक करता है

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: AI एक्ट के अनुच्छेद 50 में पाया गया यह दायित्व, एक सरल विचार पर आधारित है: लोगों को यह जानने का अधिकार है कि वे किसी इंसान के बजाय मशीन के साथ व्यवहार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: व्यवहार में, यह EU बाजार में काम करने वाली कंपनियों के लिए कई ठोस आवश्यकताओं में अनुवादित होता है।

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **चैटबॉट और वर्चुअल असिस्टेंट** को यह खुलासा करना होगा कि उपयोगकर्ता एक AI सिस्टम के साथ बातचीत कर रहा है, जब तक कि यह संदर्भ से पहले से ही स्पष्ट न हो।

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **AI-जनरेटेड या मैनिपुलेटेड इमेज, ऑडियो और वीडियो** — जिन्हें आमतौर पर डीपफेक के रूप में जाना जाता है — को कृत्रिम रूप से उत्पन्न या मैनिपुलेटेड के रूप में लेबल किया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **AI-जनरेटेड या संपादित टेक्स्ट** जिसे जनता को सार्वजनिक हित के मामलों पर सूचित करने के लिए प्रकाशित किया गया है, उसे ऐसा चिह्नित किया जाना चाहिए, जिसमें उन सामग्रियों के लिए कुछ अपवाद हैं जिनमें मानवीय संपादकीय समीक्षा हुई है।

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **इमोशन-रिकग्निशन और बायोमेट्रिक-कैटेगराइजेशन सिस्टम** को व्यक्तियों को सूचित करना होगा जब ऐसी तकनीक का उपयोग उन पर किया जा रहा हो।

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: यह नियम व्यापक रूप से लागू होता है, जिसमें न केवल AI डेवलपर्स बल्कि उन व्यवसायों को भी शामिल किया गया है जो इन उपकरणों का उपयोग करते हैं — जिसका अर्थ है कि एक रिटेलर जो तीसरे पक्ष के चैटबॉट का उपयोग कर रहा है, उदाहरण के लिए, उसकी अपनी प्रकटीकरण जिम्मेदारी है, न कि केवल उस कंपनी की जिसने अंतर्निहित मॉडल बनाया है।

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## नियामक अब इसे क्यों बढ़ावा दे रहे हैं

segments.src: The transparency requirement is part of a staged rollout that began when the AI Act entered into force in 2024.
segments.tr: पारदर्शिता की आवश्यकता एक चरणबद्ध रोलआउट का हिस्सा है जो 2024 में AI एक्ट के लागू होने पर शुरू हुआ था।

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: शुरुआती चरणों ने "अस्वीकार्य जोखिम" प्रथाओं के एक संकीर्ण सेट को प्रतिबंधित किया, जैसे कि सोशल स्कोरिंग, और सामान्य-उद्देश्य AI मॉडल प्रदाताओं के लिए दायित्व निर्धारित किए।

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: यह नवीनतम मील का पत्थर कानून की पहुंच को रोजमर्रा के उपभोक्ता-केंद्रित उपकरणों तक बढ़ाता है।

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.
segments.tr: EU अधिकारियों ने इस उपाय को गलत सूचना, घोटालों और ऑनलाइन सार्वजनिक विश्वास के क्षरण के संबंध में सिंथेटिक मीडिया की भूमिका पर बढ़ती चिंता के जवाब में बताया है।

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे AI-जनरेटेड सामग्री को मानव-निर्मित सामग्री से अलग करना कठिन हो गया है, नियामकों का तर्क है कि एक बुनियादी लेबलिंग आवश्यकता एक आनुपातिक पहला कदम है — तकनीक पर प्रतिबंध नहीं, बल्कि इसके उपयोग के चारों ओर एक सुरक्षा कवच है।

segments.src: ## The Price of Getting It Wrong
segments.tr: ## गलत होने की कीमत

segments.src: Enforcement carries real financial weight.
segments.tr: प्रवर्तन में वास्तविक वित्तीय भार है।

segments.src: Companies found to violate the transparency obligations can face fines of up to €15 million, or 3% of their total global annual revenue, whichever amount is higher.
segments.tr: पारदर्शिता दायित्वों का उल्लंघन करने वाली कंपनियों को €15 मिलियन तक का जुर्माना, या उनके कुल वैश्विक वार्षिक राजस्व का 3%, जो भी अधिक हो, देना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: For large multinational firms, that percentage-of-revenue calculation can dwarf the flat fee, making compliance a board-level concern rather than a minor legal footnote.
segments.tr: बड़ी बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनियों के लिए, राजस्व का वह प्रतिशत गणना फ्लैट शुल्क से बहुत अधिक हो सकती है, जिससे अनुपालन एक बोर्ड-स्तरीय चिंता बन जाती है, न कि केवल एक मामूली कानूनी फुटनोट।

segments.src: National market surveillance authorities in each EU member state are responsible for enforcement, working alongside the newly established EU AI Office, which coordinates oversight of general-purpose AI models across the bloc.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक EU सदस्य राज्य में राष्ट्रीय बाजार निगरानी प्राधिकरण प्रवर्तन के लिए जिम्मेदार हैं, जो नए स्थापित EU AI ऑफिस के साथ मिलकर काम करते हैं, जो पूरे ब्लॉक में सामान्य-उद्देश्य AI मॉडल की निगरानी का समन्वय करता है।

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond Europe
segments.tr: ## यूरोप के बाहर यह क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Much like the GDPR reshaped global data privacy practices after its 2018 debut, the AI Act's disclosure rules are expected to influence how companies build products well outside EU borders.
segments.tr: जिस तरह GDPR ने 2018 में अपनी शुरुआत के बाद वैश्विक डेटा गोपनीयता प्रथाओं को नया आकार दिया, AI एक्ट के प्रकटीकरण नियमों से यह उम्मीद है कि वे EU सीमाओं के बाहर कंपनियों के उत्पाद बनाने के तरीके को प्रभावित करेंगे।

segments.src: Many businesses find it simpler to apply one global standard for labeling and disclosure rather than maintaining separate versions of a product for different markets.
segments.tr: कई व्यवसायों को अलग-अलग बाजारों के लिए उत्पाद के अलग-अलग संस्करण बनाए रखने के बजाय लेबलिंग और प्रकटीकरण के लिए एक वैश्विक मानक लागू करना सरल लगता है।

segments.src: Developers of chatbots, content-generation tools, and customer-facing AI assistants are already reviewing their interfaces to add clear AI-identification notices, watermarking for synthetic media, and consent flows for emotion-detection features.
segments.tr: चैटबॉट, कंटेंट-जनरेशन टूल और ग्राहक-केंद्रित AI असिस्टेंट के डेवलपर्स पहले से ही अपने इंटरफेस की समीक्षा कर रहे हैं ताकि स्पष्ट AI-पहचान नोटिस, सिंथेटिक मीडिया के लिए वॉटरमार्किंग और इमोशन-डिटेक्शन फीचर्स के लिए सहमति प्रवाह जोड़ सकें।

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
segments.tr: रोजमर्रा के उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए, व्यावहारिक प्रभाव छोटा लेकिन सार्थक होना चाहिए: एक छोटा लेबल या नोटिस जो यह संकेत दे कि सपोर्ट चैट के दूसरी तरफ की वह मित्रवत आवाज, या ऑनलाइन प्रसारित होने वाला पॉलिश किया हुआ वीडियो क्लिप, एक मशीन द्वारा बनाया गया था या उसमें मदद ली गई थी।

segments.src: Whether that label meaningfully curbs misuse of synthetic media remains to be tested, but it marks one of the most concrete steps any major regulator has taken to draw a visible line between human and artificial communication.
segments.tr: क्या वह लेबल सिंथेटिक मीडिया के दुरुपयोग को सार्थक रूप से कम करता है, यह अभी भी परीक्षण किया जाना बाकी है, लेकिन यह किसी भी प्रमुख नियामक द्वारा मानव और कृत्रिम संचार के बीच एक दृश्य रेखा खींचने के लिए उठाए गए सबसे ठोस कदमों में से एक है।

es.title: Cada chatbot en Europa ahora debe decir "Soy una máquina": Inside the EU's New AI Disclosure Law

segments.src: Starting August 2, a new phase of the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act has taken effect, and it changes something many internet users interact with every day without a second thought: the chatbot window, the customer service assistant, and the eerily convincing video clip shared on social media.
segments.tr: A partir del 2 de agosto, ha entrado en vigor una nueva fase de la Ley de Inteligencia Artificial de la Unión Europea, y esto cambia algo con lo que muchos usuarios de internet interactúan cada día sin pensarlo: la ventana del chatbot, el asistente de servicio al cliente y el clip de vídeo inquietantemente convincente compartido en las redes sociales.

segments.src: Under the bloc's transparency rules, AI systems that interact with people, generate synthetic media, or read human emotions now have to say so, clearly and up front.
segments.tr: Bajo las reglas de transparencia del bloque, los sistemas de IA que interactúan con personas, generan medios sintéticos o leen las emociones humanas ahora deben decirlo, de manera clara y directa.

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Requires
segments.tr: ## Qué requiere realmente la norma

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: La obligación, recogida en el Artículo 50 de la Ley de IA, se basa en una idea sencilla: las personas tienen derecho a saber cuándo están tratando con una máquina en lugar de un ser humano.

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: En la práctica, esto se traduce en varios requisitos concretos para las empresas que operan en el mercado de la UE.

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **Los chatbots y asistentes virtuales** deben revelar que el usuario está interactuando con un sistema de IA, a menos que sea obvio por el contexto.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **Las imágenes, audios y vídeos generados o manipulados por IA** —comúnmente conocidos como deepfakes— deben etiquetarse como generados o manipulados artificialmente.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **El texto generado o editado por IA** publicado para informar al público sobre asuntos de interés público debe marcarse como tal, con algunas excepciones para el contenido que haya pasado por una revisión editorial humana.

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **Los sistemas de reconocimiento de emociones y categorización biométrica** deben notificar a las personas cuando se esté utilizando dicha tecnología con ellas.

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: La norma se aplica de forma amplia, abarcando no solo a los desarrolladores de IA, sino también a las empresas que despliegan estas herramientas; es decir, un minorista que utilice un chatbot de terceros, por ejemplo, tiene su propia responsabilidad de divulgación, no solo la empresa que creó el modelo subyacente.

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## Por qué los reguladores están impulsando esto ahora

segments.src: The transparency requirement is part of a staged rollout that began when the AI Act entered into force in 2024.
segments.tr: El requisito de transparencia es parte de un despliegue gradual que comenzó cuando la Ley de IA entró en vigor en 2024.

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: Fases anteriores prohibieron un conjunto restringido de prácticas de "riesgo inaceptable", como la puntuación social, y establecieron obligaciones para los proveedores de modelos de IA de propósito general.

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: Este último hito amplía el alcance de la ley a las herramientas cotidianas orientadas al consumidor.

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de la UE han planteado la medida como una respuesta a la creciente preocupación por el papel de los medios sintéticos en la desinformación, las estafas y la erosión de la confianza pública en línea.

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.
segments.tr: A medida que el contenido generado por IA se ha vuelto más difícil de distinguir del material creado por humanos, los reguladores argumentan que un requisito de etiquetado básico es un primer paso proporcionado: no una prohibición de la tecnología, sino una barrera de seguridad para su uso.

segments.src: ## The Price of Getting It Wrong
segments.tr: ## El precio de equivocarse

segments.src: Enforcement carries real financial weight.
segments.tr: La aplicación de la ley conlleva un peso financiero real.

segments.src: Companies found to violate the transparency obligations can face fines of up to €15 million, or 3% of their total global annual revenue, whichever amount is higher.
segments.tr: Las empresas que incumplan las obligaciones de transparencia pueden enfrentarse a multas de hasta 15 millones de euros, o el 3% de sus ingresos anuales globales totales, la cantidad que sea mayor.

segments.src: For large multinational firms, that percentage-of-revenue calculation can dwarf the flat fee, making compliance a board-level concern rather than a minor legal footnote.
segments.tr: Para las grandes empresas multinacionales, ese cálculo basado en el porcentaje de ingresos puede eclipsar la tarifa plana, convirtiendo el cumplimiento en una preocupación a nivel de junta directiva en lugar de una nota al pie legal menor.

segments.src: National market surveillance authorities in each EU member state are responsible for enforcement, working alongside the newly established EU AI Office, which coordinates oversight of general-purpose AI models across the bloc.
segments.tr: Las autoridades nacionales de vigilancia del mercado en cada estado miembro de la UE son responsables de la aplicación, trabajando junto con la recién creada Oficina de IA de la UE, que coordina la supervisión de los modelos de IA de propósito general en todo el bloque.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond Europe
segments.tr: ## Por qué esto importa más allá de Europa

segments.src: Much like the GDPR reshaped global data privacy practices after its 2018 debut, the AI Act's disclosure rules are expected to influence how companies build products well outside EU borders.
segments.tr: Al igual que el RGPD remodeló las prácticas globales de privacidad de datos tras su debut en 2018, se espera que las reglas de divulgación de la Ley de IA influyan en cómo las empresas crean productos mucho más allá de las fronteras de la UE.

segments.src: Many businesses find it simpler to apply one global standard for labeling and disclosure rather than maintaining separate versions of a product for different markets.
segments.tr: Muchas empresas consideran más sencillo aplicar un estándar global único para el etiquetado y la divulgación que mantener versiones separadas de un producto para diferentes mercados.

segments.src: Developers of chatbots, content-generation tools, and customer-facing AI assistants are already reviewing their interfaces to add clear AI-identification notices, watermarking for synthetic media, and consent flows for emotion-detection features.
segments.tr: Los desarrolladores de chatbots, herramientas de generación de contenido y asistentes de IA orientados al cliente ya están revisando sus interfaces para añadir avisos claros de identificación de IA, marcas de agua para medios sintéticos y flujos de consentimiento para las funciones de detección de emociones.

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
segments.tr: Para los usuarios cotidianos, el efecto práctico debería ser pequeño pero significativo: una etiqueta corta o un aviso que indique que la voz amable al otro lado de un chat de soporte, o el clip de vídeo pulido que circula en línea, fue creado o asistido por una máquina.

segments.src: Whether that label meaningfully curbs misuse of synthetic media remains to be tested, but it marks one of the most concrete steps any major regulator has taken to draw a visible line between human and artificial communication.
segments.tr: Queda por comprobar si esa etiqueta reduce significativamente el mal uso de los medios sintéticos, pero marca uno de los pasos más concretos que cualquier regulador importante ha dado para trazar una línea visible entre la comunicación humana y la artificial.

segments.tr: ## ما الذي تتطلبه القاعدة فعليًا

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: الالتزام، الموجود في المادة 50 من قانون الذكاء الاصطناعي، مبني على فكرة بسيطة: للناس الحق في معرفة متى يتعاملون مع آلة بدلاً من كائن بشري.

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: من الناحية العملية، يترجم ذلك إلى عدة متطلبات ملموسة للشركات التي تعمل في سوق الاتحاد الأوروبي.

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **روبوتات الدردشة والمساعدات الافتراضية** يجب أن تفصح عن أن المستخدم يتفاعل مع نظام ذكاء اصطناعي، ما لم يكن ذلك واضحًا بالفعل من السياق.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **الصور والصوت والفيديو المولد أو المتلاعب به بواسطة الذكاء الاصطناعي** - المعروفة باسم التزييف العميق (deepfakes) - يجب تصنيفها على أنها مولدة أو متلاعب بها اصطناعيًا.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **النصوص المولدة أو المحررة بواسطة الذكاء الاصطناعي** المنشورة لإبلاغ الجمهور في مسائل ذات مصلحة عامة يجب تمييزها على هذا النحو، مع بعض الاستثناءات للمحتوى الذي خضع لمراجعة تحريرية بشرية.

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **أنظمة التعرف على العواطف والتصنيف البيومتري** يجب أن تخطر الأفراد عندما يتم استخدام هذه التكنولوجيا عليهم.

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: تنطبق القاعدة على نطاق واسع، حيث لا تغطي مطوري الذكاء الاصطناعي فحسب، بل أيضًا الشركات التي تنشر هذه الأدوات - مما يعني أن تاجر التجزئة الذي يستخدم روبوت دردشة من طرف ثالث، على سبيل المثال، يتحمل مسؤولية الإفصاح الخاصة به، وليس فقط الشركة التي بنت النموذج الأساسي.

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## لماذا يضغط المنظمون على هذا الآن

segments.src: The transparency requirement is part of a staged rollout that began when the AI Act entered into force in 2024.
segments.tr: متطلب الشفافية هو جزء من عملية طرح تدريجية بدأت عندما دخل قانون الذكاء الاصطناعي حيز التنفيذ في عام 2024.

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: حظرت المراحل المبكرة مجموعة ضيقة من ممارسات "المخاطر غير المقبولة"، مثل التقييم الاجتماعي، ووضعت التزامات لمزودي نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي للأغراض العامة.

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: هذا المعلم الأخير يوسع نطاق القانون ليشمل الأدوات اليومية الموجهة للمستهلكين.

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.
segments.tr: صاغ المسؤولون في الاتحاد الأوروبي هذا الإجراء كاستجابة للقلق المتزايد بشأن دور الوسائط الاصطناعية في التضليل، وعمليات الاحتيال، وتآكل الثقة العامة عبر الإنترنت.

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.
segments.tr: بما أن المحتوى المولد بواسطة الذكاء الاصطناعي أصبح من الصعب تمييزه عن المواد التي يصنعها البشر، يرى المنظمون أن متطلب التصنيف الأساسي هو خطوة أولى متناسبة - ليس حظرًا للتكنولوجيا، بل حاجز حماية حول استخدامها.

segments.src: ## The Price of Getting It Wrong
segments.tr: ## ثمن الخطأ

segments.src: Enforcement carries real financial weight.
segments.tr: التنفيذ يحمل ثقلاً ماليًا حقيقيًا.

segments.src: Companies found to violate the transparency obligations can face fines of up to €15 million, or 3% of their total global annual revenue, whichever amount is higher.
segments.tr: الشركات التي يثبت انتهاكها لالتزامات الشفافية قد تواجه غرامات تصل إلى 15 مليون يورو، أو 3% من إجمالي إيراداتها السنوية العالمية، أيهما أعلى.

segments.src: For large multinational firms, that percentage-of-revenue calculation can dwarf the flat fee, making compliance a board-level concern rather than a minor legal footnote.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للشركات الكبرى متعددة الجنسيات، يمكن أن يتجاوز حساب النسبة المئوية من الإيرادات الرسوم الثابتة، مما يجعل الامتثال مصدر قلق على مستوى مجلس الإدارة بدلاً من مجرد ملاحظة قانونية ثانوية.

segments.src: National market surveillance authorities in each EU member state are responsible for enforcement, working alongside the newly established EU AI Office, which coordinates oversight of general-purpose AI models across the bloc.
segments.tr: سلطات مراقبة السوق الوطنية في كل دولة عضو في الاتحاد الأوروبي مسؤولة عن التنفيذ، وتعمل جنبًا إلى جنب مع مكتب الذكاء الاصطناعي التابع للاتحاد الأوروبي الذي تم إنشاؤه حديثًا، والذي ينسق الإشراف على نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي للأغراض العامة في جميع أنحاء التكتل.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond Europe
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم هذا خارج أوروبا

segments.src: Much like the GDPR reshaped global data privacy practices after its 2018 debut, the AI Act's disclosure rules are expected to influence how companies build products well outside EU borders.
segments.tr: تمامًا كما أعاد GDPR تشكيل ممارسات خصوصية البيانات العالمية بعد ظهوره في عام 2018، من المتوقع أن تؤثر قواعد الإفصاح في قانون الذكاء الاصطناعي على كيفية بناء الشركات للمنتجات خارج حدود الاتحاد الأوروبي.

segments.src: Many businesses find it simpler to apply one global standard for labeling and disclosure rather than maintaining separate versions of a product for different markets.
segments.tr: تجد العديد من الشركات أنه من الأبسط تطبيق معيار عالمي واحد للتصنيف والإفصاح بدلاً من الحفاظ على إصدارات منفصلة من المنتج لأسواق مختلفة.

segments.src: Developers of chatbots, content-generation tools, and customer-facing AI assistants are already reviewing their interfaces to add clear AI-identification notices, watermarking for synthetic media, and consent flows for emotion-detection features.
segments.tr: يقوم مطورو روبوتات الدردشة، وأدوات توليد المحتوى، ومساعدي الذكاء الاصطناعي الموجهين للعملاء بالفعل بمراجعة واجهاتهم لإضافة إشعارات واضحة بتحديد هوية الذكاء الاصطناعي، والعلامات المائية للوسائط الاصطناعية، وتدفقات الموافقة لميزات اكتشاف العواطف.

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمستخدمين العاديين، يجب أن يكون التأثير العملي صغيرًا ولكن ذا معنى: ملصق أو إشعار قصير يشير إلى أن الصوت الودود في الطرف الآخر من دردشة الدعم، أو مقطع الفيديو المصقول الذي يتم تداوله عبر الإنترنت، تم إنشاؤه أو بمساعدة آلة.

segments.src: Whether that label meaningfully curbs misuse of synthetic media remains to be tested, but it marks one of the most concrete steps any major regulator has taken to draw a visible line between human and artificial communication.
segments.tr: سواء كان هذا الملصق يحد بشكل ملموس من إساءة استخدام الوسائط الاصطناعية، فهذا أمر لا يزال قيد الاختبار، لكنه يمثل إحدى أكثر الخطوات الملموسة التي اتخذها أي منظم رئيسي لرسم خط مرئي بين التواصل البشري والاصطناعي.

fr.title: Chaque chatbot en Europe doit désormais dire « Je suis une machine » : zoom sur la nouvelle loi de l'UE sur la divulgation de l'IA

segments.src: Starting August 2, a new phase of the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act has taken effect, and it changes something many internet users interact with every day without a second thought: the chatbot window, the customer service assistant, and the eerily convincing video clip shared on social media.
segments.tr: À partir du 2 août, une nouvelle phase de la loi sur l'intelligence artificielle de l'Union européenne est entrée en vigueur, et elle modifie quelque chose avec lequel de nombreux utilisateurs d'Internet interagissent chaque jour sans y réfléchir : la fenêtre de chatbot, l'assistant de service client et le clip vidéo étrangement convaincant partagé sur les réseaux sociaux.

segments.src: Under the bloc's transparency rules, AI systems that interact with people, generate synthetic media, or read human emotions now have to say so, clearly and up front.
segments.tr: En vertu des règles de transparence du bloc, les systèmes d'IA qui interagissent avec des personnes, génèrent des médias synthétiques ou lisent les émotions humaines doivent désormais le dire, clairement et d'emblée.

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Requires
segments.tr: ## Ce que la règle exige réellement

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: L'obligation, stipulée à l'article 50 de la loi sur l'IA, repose sur une idée simple : les gens ont le droit de savoir quand ils traitent avec une machine plutôt qu'avec un être humain.

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: En pratique, cela se traduit par plusieurs exigences concrètes pour les entreprises opérant sur le marché de l'UE.

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **Les chatbots et assistants virtuels** doivent divulguer qu'un utilisateur interagit avec un système d'IA, à moins que cela ne soit déjà évident d'après le contexte.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **Les images, l'audio et la vidéo générés ou manipulés par l'IA** — communément appelés deepfakes — doivent être étiquetés comme étant générés ou manipulés artificiellement.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **Le texte généré ou édité par l'IA** publié pour informer le public sur des questions d'intérêt public doit être marqué comme tel, avec quelques exceptions pour le contenu ayant fait l'objet d'une révision éditoriale humaine.

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **Les systèmes de reconnaissance des émotions et de catégorisation biométrique** doivent informer les individus lorsque cette technologie est utilisée sur eux.

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: La règle s'applique largement, couvrant non seulement les développeurs d'IA, mais aussi les entreprises qui déploient ces outils — ce qui signifie qu'un détaillant utilisant un chatbot tiers, par exemple, assume sa propre responsabilité de divulgation, et pas seulement l'entreprise qui a construit le modèle sous-jacent.

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les régulateurs poussent-ils cela maintenant

segments.src: The transparency requirement is part of a staged rollout that began when the AI Act entered into force in 2024.
segments.tr: L'exigence de transparence fait partie d'un déploiement progressif qui a commencé lorsque la loi sur l'IA est entrée en vigueur en 2024.

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: Les phases précédentes ont interdit un ensemble restreint de pratiques à « risque inacceptable », telles que le scoring social, et ont fixé des obligations pour les fournisseurs de modèles d'IA à usage général.

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: Ce dernier jalon étend la portée de la loi aux outils quotidiens destinés aux consommateurs.

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.
segments.tr: Les responsables de l'UE ont présenté la mesure comme une réponse aux préoccupations croissantes concernant le rôle des médias synthétiques dans la désinformation, les escroqueries et l'érosion de la confiance du public en ligne.

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.
segments.tr: Alors que le contenu généré par l'IA est devenu plus difficile à distinguer du matériel produit par l'homme, les régulateurs soutiennent qu'une exigence d'étiquetage de base est une première étape proportionnée — non pas une interdiction de la technologie, mais un garde-fou autour de son utilisation.

segments.src: ## The Price of Getting It Wrong
segments.tr: ## Le prix d'une erreur

segments.src: Enforcement carries real financial weight.
segments.tr: L'application comporte un poids financier réel.

segments.src: Companies found to violate the transparency obligations can face fines of up to €15 million, or 3% of their total global annual revenue, whichever amount is higher.
segments.tr: Les entreprises reconnues coupables de violation des obligations de transparence s'exposent à des amendes pouvant atteindre 15 millions d'euros, ou 3 % de leur chiffre d'affaires annuel mondial total, le montant le plus élevé étant retenu.

segments.src: For large multinational firms, that percentage-of-revenue calculation can dwarf the flat fee, making compliance a board-level concern rather than a minor legal footnote.
segments.tr: Pour les grandes multinationales, ce calcul basé sur le pourcentage du chiffre d'affaires peut éclipser le forfait, faisant de la conformité une préoccupation au niveau du conseil d'administration plutôt qu'une simple note de bas de page juridique.

segments.src: National market surveillance authorities in each EU member state are responsible for enforcement, working alongside the newly established EU AI Office, which coordinates oversight of general-purpose AI models across the bloc.
segments.tr: Les autorités nationales de surveillance du marché dans chaque État membre de l'UE sont responsables de l'application, travaillant aux côtés du bureau de l'IA de l'UE nouvellement créé, qui coordonne la surveillance des modèles d'IA à usage général à travers le bloc.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond Europe
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cela importe au-delà de l'Europe

segments.src: Much like the GDPR reshaped global data privacy practices after its 2018 debut, the AI Act's disclosure rules are expected to influence how companies build products well outside EU borders.
segments.tr: Tout comme le RGPD a remodelé les pratiques mondiales de confidentialité des données après ses débuts en 2018, les règles de divulgation de la loi sur l'IA devraient influencer la manière dont les entreprises conçoivent des produits bien au-delà des frontières de l'UE.

segments.src: Many businesses find it simpler to apply one global standard for labeling and disclosure rather than maintaining separate versions of a product for different markets.
segments.tr: De nombreuses entreprises trouvent plus simple d'appliquer une norme mondiale unique pour l'étiquetage et la divulgation plutôt que de maintenir des versions distinctes d'un produit pour différents marchés.

segments.src: Developers of chatbots, content-generation tools, and customer-facing AI assistants are already reviewing their interfaces to add clear AI-identification notices, watermarking for synthetic media, and consent flows for emotion-detection features.
segments.tr: Les développeurs de chatbots, d'outils de génération de contenu et d'assistants d'IA destinés aux clients examinent déjà leurs interfaces pour ajouter des avis d'identification de l'IA clairs, du tatouage numérique pour les médias synthétiques et des flux de consentement pour les fonctionnalités de détection des émotions.

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
segments.tr: Pour les utilisateurs quotidiens, l'effet pratique devrait être faible mais significatif : une courte étiquette ou un avis indiquant que la voix amicale à l'autre bout d'un chat de support, ou le clip vidéo poli circulant en ligne, a été créé ou assisté par une machine.

segments.src: Whether that label meaningfully curbs misuse of synthetic media remains to be tested, but it marks one of the most concrete steps any major regulator has taken to draw a visible line between human and artificial communication.
segments.tr: Que cette étiquette limite concrètement l'utilisation abusive des médias synthétiques reste à tester, mais elle marque l'une des étapes les plus concrètes qu'un régulateur majeur ait entreprises pour tracer une ligne visible entre la communication humaine et artificielle.

pt.title: Todo Chatbot na Europa Agora Deve Dizer "Sou uma Máquina": Por Dentro da Nova Lei de Divulgação de IA da UE

segments.src: Starting August 2, a new phase of the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act has taken effect, and it changes something many internet users interact with every day without a second thought: the chatbot window, the customer service assistant, and the eerily convincing video clip shared on social media.
segments.tr: A partir de 2 de agosto, uma nova fase da Lei de Inteligência Artificial da União Europeia entrou em vigor, e ela altera algo com que muitos usuários de internet interagem todos os dias sem pensar duas vezes: a janela do chatbot, o assistente de atendimento ao cliente e o clipe de vídeo estranhamente convincente compartilhado nas redes sociais.

segments.src: Under the bloc's transparency rules, AI systems that interact with people, generate synthetic media, or read human emotions now have to say so, clearly and up front.
segments.tr: Sob as regras de transparência do bloco, os sistemas de IA que interagem com pessoas, geram mídia sintética ou leem emoções humanas agora têm que declarar isso, de forma clara e antecipada.

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Requires
segments.tr: ## O Que a Regra Realmente Exige

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: A obrigação, encontrada no Artigo 50 da Lei de IA, baseia-se em uma ideia simples: as pessoas têm o direito de saber quando estão lidando com uma máquina em vez de um ser humano.

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: Na prática, isso se traduz em vários requisitos concretos para as empresas que operam no mercado da UE.

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **Chatbots e assistentes virtuais** devem divulgar que o usuário está interagindo com um sistema de IA, a menos que isso já seja óbvio pelo contexto.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **Imagens, áudios e vídeos gerados ou manipulados por IA** — comumente conhecidos como deepfakes — devem ser rotulados como gerados ou manipulados artificialmente.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **Texto gerado ou editado por IA** publicado para informar o público sobre assuntos de interesse público deve ser marcado como tal, com algumas exceções para conteúdo que passou por revisão editorial humana.

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **Sistemas de reconhecimento de emoções e categorização biométrica** devem notificar os indivíduos quando tal tecnologia estiver sendo usada neles.

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: A regra se aplica amplamente, abrangendo não apenas os desenvolvedores de IA, mas também as empresas que implantam essas ferramentas — significando que um varejista que usa um chatbot de terceiros, por exemplo, carrega sua própria responsabilidade de divulgação, não apenas a empresa que construiu o modelo subjacente.

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## Por Que os Reguladores Estão Impulsionando Isso Agora

segments.tr: O requisito de transparência faz parte de um lançamento gradual que começou quando a Lei de IA entrou em vigor em 2024.

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: Fases anteriores proibiram um conjunto estreito de práticas de "risco inaceitável", como a pontuação social, e estabeleceram obrigações para provedores de modelos de IA de propósito geral.

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: Este marco mais recente estende o alcance da lei para ferramentas cotidianas voltadas ao consumidor.

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.

segments.tr: Para grandes empresas multinacionais, esse cálculo de porcentagem de receita pode anular a taxa fixa, tornando a conformidade uma preocupação de nível de diretoria, em vez de uma simples nota de rodapé legal.

segments.src: National market surveillance authorities in each EU member state are responsible for enforcement, working alongside the newly established EU AI Office, which coordinates oversight of general-purpose AI models across the bloc.
segments.tr: As autoridades nacionais de vigilância de mercado em cada estado-membro da UE são responsáveis pela fiscalização, trabalhando ao lado do recém-criado Escritório de IA da UE, que coordena a supervisão de modelos de IA de propósito geral em todo o bloco.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond Europe
segments.tr: ## Por Que Isso Importa Além da Europa

segments.src: Much like the GDPR reshaped global data privacy practices after its 2018 debut, the AI Act's disclosure rules are expected to influence how companies build products well outside EU borders.
segments.tr: Assim como o GDPR remodelou as práticas globais de privacidade de dados após sua estreia em 2018, as regras de divulgação da Lei de IA devem influenciar a forma como as empresas constroem produtos bem além das fronteiras da UE.

segments.src: Many businesses find it simpler to apply one global standard for labeling and disclosure rather than maintaining separate versions of a product for different markets.
segments.tr: Muitas empresas acham mais simples aplicar um padrão global único para rotulagem e divulgação do que manter versões separadas de um produto para diferentes mercados.

segments.src: Developers of chatbots, content-generation tools, and customer-facing AI assistants are already reviewing their interfaces to add clear AI-identification notices, watermarking for synthetic media, and consent flows for emotion-detection features.
segments.tr: Desenvolvedores de chatbots, ferramentas de geração de conteúdo e assistentes de IA voltados ao cliente já estão revisando suas interfaces para adicionar avisos claros de identificação de IA, marcas d'água para mídia sintética e fluxos de consentimento para recursos de detecção de emoções.

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
segments.tr: Para os usuários comuns, o efeito prático deve ser pequeno, mas significativo: um rótulo ou aviso curto indicando que a voz amigável do outro lado de um chat de suporte, ou o clipe de vídeo polido circulando online, foi criado ou auxiliado por uma máquina.

segments.src: Whether that label meaningfully curbs misuse of synthetic media remains to be tested, but it marks one of the most concrete steps any major regulator has taken to draw a visible line between human and artificial communication.
segments.tr: Se esse rótulo reduzirá significativamente o mau uso da mídia sintética, ainda resta a ser testado, mas marca um dos passos mais concretos que qualquer grande regulador tomou para traçar uma linha visível entre a comunicação humana e a artificial.

in.title: Setiap Chatbot di Eropa Kini Harus Mengatakan "Saya adalah Mesin": Di Balik Hukum Pengungkapan AI Baru Uni Eropa

segments.src: Starting August 2, a new phase of the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act has taken effect, and it changes something many internet users interact with every day without a second thought: the chatbot window, the customer service assistant, and the eerily convincing video clip shared on social media.
segments.tr: Mulai 2 Agustus, fase baru dari Undang-Undang Kecerdasan Buatan Uni Eropa telah berlaku, dan hal ini mengubah sesuatu yang berinteraksi dengan banyak pengguna internet setiap hari tanpa berpikir panjang: jendela chatbot, asisten layanan pelanggan, dan klip video yang sangat meyakinkan yang dibagikan di media sosial.

segments.src: Under the bloc's transparency rules, AI systems that interact with people, generate synthetic media, or read human emotions now have to say so, clearly and up front.
segments.tr: Di bawah aturan transparansi blok tersebut, sistem AI yang berinteraksi dengan orang, menghasilkan media sintetis, atau membaca emosi manusia kini harus mengatakannya, secara jelas dan di awal.

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Requires
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Sebenarnya Diperlukan oleh Aturan Ini

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: Kewajiban ini, yang ditemukan dalam Pasal 50 dari AI Act, dibangun berdasarkan ide sederhana: orang-orang berhak tahu kapan mereka berurusan dengan mesin, bukan manusia.

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: Dalam praktiknya, hal itu diterjemahkan menjadi beberapa persyaratan konkret bagi perusahaan yang beroperasi di pasar UE.

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **Chatbot dan asisten virtual** harus mengungkapkan bahwa pengguna sedang berinteraksi dengan sistem AI, kecuali jika hal itu sudah jelas dari konteksnya.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **Gambar, audio, dan video yang dihasilkan atau dimanipulasi AI** — yang umum dikenal sebagai deepfake — harus diberi label sebagai hasil generasi atau manipulasi buatan.

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **Teks yang dihasilkan atau diedit AI** yang dipublikasikan untuk menginformasikan publik tentang masalah kepentingan publik harus ditandai demikian, dengan beberapa pengecualian untuk konten yang telah melalui tinjauan editorial manusia.

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **Sistem pengenalan emosi dan kategorisasi biometrik** harus memberi tahu individu ketika teknologi tersebut digunakan pada mereka.

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: Aturan ini berlaku secara luas, mencakup tidak hanya pengembang AI tetapi juga bisnis yang menerapkan alat-alat ini — artinya, pengecer yang menggunakan chatbot pihak ketiga, misalnya, memikul tanggung jawab pengungkapan mereka sendiri, bukan hanya perusahaan yang membangun model dasarnya.

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Regulator Mendorong Hal Ini Sekarang

segments.src: The transparency requirement is part of a staged rollout that began when the AI Act entered into force in 2024.
segments.tr: Persyaratan transparansi ini adalah bagian dari peluncuran bertahap yang dimulai ketika AI Act mulai berlaku pada tahun 2024.

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: Fase-fase sebelumnya melarang serangkaian praktik "risiko yang tidak dapat diterima" yang sempit, seperti penilaian sosial, dan menetapkan kewajiban bagi penyedia model AI tujuan umum.

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: Tonggak sejarah terbaru ini memperluas jangkauan undang-undang ke alat-alat yang menghadap konsumen sehari-hari.

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.
segments.tr: Pejabat UE membingkai langkah ini sebagai respons terhadap kekhawatiran yang meningkat atas peran media sintetis dalam misinformasi, penipuan, dan pengikisan kepercayaan publik secara daring.

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.
segments.tr: Karena konten yang dihasilkan AI menjadi lebih sulit dibedakan dari materi buatan manusia, regulator berpendapat bahwa persyaratan pelabelan dasar adalah langkah pertama yang proporsional — bukan larangan terhadap teknologi tersebut, tetapi pagar pengaman di sekitar penggunaannya.

segments.src: ## The Price of Getting It Wrong
segments.tr: ## Harga dari Kesalahan

segments.src: Enforcement carries real financial weight.
segments.tr: Penegakan hukum membawa beban finansial yang nyata.

segments.src: Companies found to violate the transparency obligations can face fines of up to €15 million, or 3% of their total global annual revenue, whichever amount is higher.
segments.tr: Perusahaan yang terbukti melanggar kewajiban transparansi dapat menghadapi denda hingga €15 juta, atau 3% dari total pendapatan tahunan global mereka, mana yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: For large multinational firms, that percentage-of-revenue calculation can dwarf the flat fee, making compliance a board-level concern rather than a minor legal footnote.
segments.tr: Bagi perusahaan multinasional besar, perhitungan persentase pendapatan tersebut dapat mengerdilkan biaya tetap, menjadikan kepatuhan sebagai perhatian tingkat dewan direksi daripada sekadar catatan kaki hukum yang kecil.

segments.src: National market surveillance authorities in each EU member state are responsible for enforcement, working alongside the newly established EU AI Office, which coordinates oversight of general-purpose AI models across the bloc.
segments.tr: Otoritas pengawasan pasar nasional di setiap negara anggota UE bertanggung jawab atas penegakan hukum, bekerja bersama Kantor AI UE yang baru didirikan, yang mengoordinasikan pengawasan model AI tujuan umum di seluruh blok tersebut.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond Europe
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Ini Penting di Luar Eropa

segments.tr: Sama seperti GDPR membentuk kembali praktik privasi data global setelah debutnya pada tahun 2018, aturan pengungkapan AI Act diharapkan akan memengaruhi cara perusahaan membangun produk jauh di luar perbatasan UE.

segments.src: Many businesses find it simpler to apply one global standard for labeling and disclosure rather than maintaining separate versions of a product for different markets.
segments.tr: Banyak bisnis merasa lebih sederhana untuk menerapkan satu standar global untuk pelabelan dan pengungkapan daripada mempertahankan versi produk yang terpisah untuk pasar yang berbeda.

segments.src: Developers of chatbots, content-generation tools, and customer-facing AI assistants are already reviewing their interfaces to add clear AI-identification notices, watermarking for synthetic media, and consent flows for emotion-detection features.
segments.tr: Pengembang chatbot, alat pembuat konten, dan asisten AI yang menghadap pelanggan sudah meninjau antarmuka mereka untuk menambahkan pemberitahuan identifikasi AI yang jelas, watermark untuk media sintetis, dan alur persetujuan untuk fitur deteksi emosi.

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
segments.tr: Bagi pengguna sehari-hari, efek praktisnya seharusnya kecil namun berarti: label atau pemberitahuan singkat yang menunjukkan bahwa suara ramah di ujung chat dukungan, atau klip video mengkilap yang beredar secara daring, dibuat atau dibantu oleh mesin.

segments.src: Whether that label meaningfully curbs misuse of synthetic media remains to be tested, but it marks one of the most concrete steps any major regulator has taken to draw a visible line between human and artificial communication.
segments.tr: Apakah label tersebut secara berarti dapat membendung penyalahgunaan media sintetis masih harus diuji, tetapi hal ini menandai salah satu langkah paling konkret yang diambil oleh regulator utama mana pun untuk menarik garis yang terlihat antara komunikasi manusia dan buatan.

ja.title: 欧州のすべてのチャットボットは「私は機械です」と言わなければならない：EUの新しいAI開示法の内側

segments.src: Starting August 2, a new phase of the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act has taken effect, and it changes something many internet users interact with every day without a second thought: the chatbot window, the customer service assistant, and the eerily convincing video clip shared on social media.

segments.src: Under the bloc's transparency rules, AI systems that interact with people, generate synthetic media, or read human emotions now have to say so, clearly and up front.
segments.tr: EUの透明性ルールに基づき、人間と対話する、合成メディアを生成する、または人間の感情を読み取るAIシステムは、その旨を明確かつ事前に告知しなければなりません。

segments.src: ## What the Rule Actually Requires
segments.tr: ## ルールの実際の内容

segments.src: The obligation, found in Article 50 of the AI Act, is built around a simple idea: people have a right to know when they are dealing with a machine instead of a human being.
segments.tr: AI法第50条に規定されているこの義務は、シンプルな考えに基づいています。それは、人々が人間ではなく機械とやり取りしていることを知る権利があるということです。

segments.src: In practice, that translates into several concrete requirements for companies operating in the EU market.
segments.tr: 実際には、これはEU市場で事業を展開する企業にとって、いくつかの具体的な要件に翻訳されます。

segments.src: - **Chatbots and virtual assistants** must disclose that a user is interacting with an AI system, unless it is already obvious from the context.
segments.tr: - **チャットボットや仮想アシスタント**は、文脈から明らかな場合を除き、ユーザーがAIシステムと対話していることを開示しなければなりません。

segments.src: - **AI-generated or manipulated images, audio, and video** — commonly known as deepfakes — must be labeled as artificially generated or manipulated.
segments.tr: - **AI生成または操作された画像、音声、ビデオ**（一般的にディープフェイクとして知られる）は、人工的に生成または操作されたものであるとラベル付けされなければなりません。

segments.src: - **AI-generated or edited text** published to inform the public on matters of public interest must be marked as such, with some exceptions for content that has undergone human editorial review.
segments.tr: - **AI生成または編集されたテキスト**で、公共の利益に関する事項について一般に知らせるために公開されたものは、その旨を明記しなければなりません。ただし、人間の編集レビューを経たコンテンツについては一部例外があります。

segments.src: - **Emotion-recognition and biometric-categorization systems** must notify individuals when such technology is being used on them.
segments.tr: - **感情認識および生体認証カテゴリー化システム**は、そのような技術が使用されている場合に個人に通知しなければなりません。

segments.src: The rule applies broadly, covering not just AI developers but also the businesses that deploy these tools — meaning a retailer using a third-party chatbot, for example, carries its own disclosure responsibility, not just the company that built the underlying model.
segments.tr: このルールは幅広く適用され、AI開発者だけでなく、これらのツールを導入する企業も対象となります。つまり、例えばサードパーティのチャットボットを使用している小売業者は、基盤モデルを構築した会社だけでなく、自社でも開示責任を負います。

segments.src: ## Why Regulators Are Pushing This Now
segments.tr: ## なぜ規制当局は今これを推進しているのか

segments.tr: 透明性要件は、2024年にAI法が施行された際に始まった段階的な導入の一環です。

segments.src: Earlier phases banned a narrow set of "unacceptable risk" practices, such as social scoring, and set obligations for general-purpose AI model providers.
segments.tr: 初期の段階では、ソーシャルスコアリングなどの「許容できないリスク」を伴う限定的な慣行が禁止され、汎用AIモデルプロバイダーに対する義務が設定されました。

segments.src: This latest milestone extends the law's reach into everyday consumer-facing tools.
segments.tr: 今回の最新のマイルストーンは、法の適用範囲を日常的な消費者向けツールにまで広げたものです。

segments.src: EU officials have framed the measure as a response to growing concern over synthetic media's role in misinformation, scams, and erosion of public trust online.
segments.tr: EU当局者は、この措置を、合成メディアが誤情報、詐欺、そしてオンライン上の公的信頼の低下に果たす役割に対する懸念の高まりへの対応として位置づけています。

segments.src: As AI-generated content has become harder to distinguish from human-made material, regulators argue that a basic labeling requirement is a proportionate first step — not a ban on the technology, but a guardrail around its use.
segments.tr: AI生成コンテンツが人間が作成した資料と区別しにくくなっているため、規制当局は、基本的なラベル付け要件が比例的な第一歩であると主張しています。これは技術の禁止ではなく、その利用に関するガードレールを設けることです。

segments.src: ## The Price of Getting It Wrong
segments.tr: ## 違反した場合の代償

segments.src: Enforcement carries real financial weight.
segments.tr: 執行には、実質的な金銭的重みがあります。

segments.src: For large multinational firms, that percentage-of-revenue calculation can dwarf the flat fee, making compliance a board-level concern rather than a minor legal footnote.

segments.src: For everyday users, the practical effect should be a small but meaningful one: a short label or notice indicating that the friendly voice on the other end of a support chat, or the polished video clip circulating online, was created or assisted by a machine.
